autonomy.note: OpenCode 2's default permissions allow every tool and ask only before reading .env files. It has no approval-skipping flag; the defaults are kept, because the box is the boundary.

verified.notes: The npm package @opencode/cli is a launcher whose command only works after its postinstall script, so the lockfile pins the platform package @opencode/cli-linux-x64-baseline (one prebuilt program) instead, installed with scripts off. Built into an ezbx box image beside Pi; opencode --version gives 'opencode v2.3.2'. On the isolated network with the network off, opencode run answered through the gateway with a fake engine. At every run it fetched its model catalogue from models.opencode.ai (refused by the gateway); OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1 stops that, and with it no request left the box except to the gateway. Its talk with its own background service stays on the box's loopback (NO_PROXY). Not yet checked: its file tools with a real model, and its full-screen interface through ezbx shell.
